spec.name: sprint35_taker_imbalance_liquid_largecap
spec.hypothesis: Short-horizon taker buy/sell volume imbalance in top-of-book order flow predicts next-N-minute mid-price drift in liquid large-caps, net of realistic intraday costs.
spec.power_argument: Target n>=300 validation trades over the sealed test window at entry_per_day_cap=3 across a ~15-name liquid basket (~7 trading days). Prior sprints (32/34) show realized intraday cost drag of 30-36bps on similar hold windows in illiquid names; liquid large-cap spreads/impact should be materially lower (est. <5bps round-trip). Set min detectable edge at 8bps net (two-sided t-test, alpha=0.05, power=0.8) — well above the ~5bps cost floor, so a pass is falsifiable and a null result is informative rather than a foregone conclusion.
